method.sourceAccess: Public first-party page retrieval plus baseline repository static source and read-only GitHub API inspection

evidenceTypes.public_page_observation: Labels, metadata and links present in the retrieved public first-party page; not an interaction replay
evidenceTypes.official_documentation_claim: Behavior described by the provider; not verified within an authenticated product
evidenceTypes.local_static_observation: Baseline source or test content inspected; not proof of current browser behavior
evidenceTypes.design_inference: Our proposed product decision or acceptance target, not a competitor metric
evidenceTypes.ci_log_observation: Specific existing remote CI job and log inspected

sources.title: Pilates Anytime exercise library
supportedClaims: Apparatus and level navigation are exposed
Exercise entries include instructor, difficulty, duration and apparatus metadata
limitations: Filter behavior, mobile layout and member player were not exercised

sources.title: Pilatesology Classes
supportedClaims: Search, filters and clear controls are exposed
Workout and Observe & Learn are distinct class types
Duration, teacher and level or tempo appear in class entries

sources.title: Creating and using custom playlists
supportedClaims: Documentation describes adding a thumbnail to a chosen playlist, rearranging entries, seeing its count and returning from a video to the playlist
limitations: Documentation may describe an older interface
Current signed-in behavior was not reproduced

sources.title: Forme Pilates features
supportedClaims: Provider describes library insertion, ordering, sections, target and running total
Teach mode describes current cues and springs with the next setup
sources.shortExcerpt: Target length with a live total
limitations: No measured time savings, AI plan quality or safety validation
Do not conflate this .app domain with similarly named products

sources.title: How to watch videos in your language
supportedClaims: Help distinguishes site language, class-language filtering, audio tracks and subtitles
limitations: Language availability for individual videos was not verified
This does not justify treating country metadata as audio language

sources.title: Sequence/OS FAQ
supportedClaims: FAQ describes sequence ordering, durations, reusable groups and focused current/next teaching information
FAQ explicitly describes a product without pose images
limitations: Adjacent yoga planner, not a Pilates authority
Not used as evidence of superior motion imagery or medical safety

localFindings.claim: The normal atlas entry renders FlowAtlasCatalog; additional source and authoring tools have a separate advanced entry. Preserve this structure while improving exit and focus continuity.
Insertion position, recent insertion feedback, duration summary and preparation actions already exist; extend their contracts instead of introducing another editor.
Video selection and explicit playback are separate; region filters are country metadata, not verified audio or subtitle languages.
Focused teaching presentation and current/next information exist. Preserve native-motion versus source-only coverage rather than implying universal native animation.

recommendations.inference: Keep search and apparatus primary, disclose optional controls and preserve discovery state on return.
acceptanceTargets: At most two explicit actions from a valid selected result to insertion
Close does not clear search or filters
Logical focus returns after detail/filter exit
Empty-state reset and scope expansion remain distinct

recommendations.inference: Show the active insertion point and resulting order in the existing workflow.
acceptanceTargets: One successful add produces exactly one entry
Count, duration and resulting position agree
Stale insertion anchors require a new valid selection
Undo, locks, rests, side data and source metadata survive
Unsaved drafts remain usable

recommendations.inference: Summarize concrete readiness facts and the next action; keep target mismatch distinct from actual blockers.
acceptanceTargets: Each blocker has a concrete explanation and relevant action
No new blocking rule based only on target-time mismatch
View changes preserve clock, voice and source context
Idle unchanged stage exit adds no unnecessary confirmation
Running session replacement follows existing exit decision

recommendations.inference: Use one clear media stage with readable attribution and controlled playback; preserve accurate source and language semantics.
acceptanceTargets: Selecting a thumbnail alone does not autoplay
Title, channel and exercise relationship remain readable
Image failure preserves a fallback and source link
Reduced-motion, paused and hidden states do not introduce unsolicited motion
Check overflow at 360, 390, 768 and 1280 CSS pixels with 44px primary touch targets
Consistent figure/apparatus proportions, complete limbs and continuous contacts are visual review targets, not a safety certification

remoteDuplicateAudit.method: Read-only GitHub GETs and matching baseline source inspection
alreadyPresent: Sequence authoring/rehearsal eligibility and moved-occurrence context guards in InstructorScheduleView
LiveStage exit decision, exact step-jump/time-add undo and record-failure retention
Idle unchanged session exit without a redundant decision
importantLimits: Schedule warnings/time conflicts affect readiness labeling but are not direct predicates of canStartDatedStage or canStartLinkedStage
LiveStage clock is initialized in component memory; examined code does not prove recovery of a running timer after browser termination
visibilitychange samples elapsed time; it is not an automatic timer-pause policy
No separate unmerged remote patch was found; this does not rule out deleted branches or other local machines

ciEvidence.limit: Existing baseline CI evidence only; does not validate subsequent changes

legacyEvidenceHandling.treatment: Historical repository record, not fresh REA evidence
notAdoptedAsCompetitorOrSafetyFacts: Prior AST/DOM counts and bundle hashes
Composite readiness score as a validated standard

unverified: Authenticated competitor flows and current paid product UI
Competitor click counts, task times, satisfaction or superiority
Production deployment or production user data

limits: Selected regression suite only, not the full suite or final integrated commit
